## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION — Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (weak breadth). Market mixed with narrow tech leadership and pockets of energy strength; confirmation: weak overall sector breadth (3/11) and top-performer concentration skewed to Technology (Leadership: Narrow, 4/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leading: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND. Technology up on select names: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Communication showing modest upside via AMZN (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -8.49%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weakest: CRH (1W: -11.31% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND; PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND; MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft with major names under pressure: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -11.31% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND; MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND; UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Materials and select Tech/industrial hardware.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE present — multiple large-cap names (MSFT, AMZN, MA, IBM) show 1W vs 1M disagreement; treat moves as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internally: NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND while AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY. Select software/enterprise names leading (INTU, NOW, ADBE) but hardware/semiconductor names show bifurcation; Sector breadth: Technology positive (24 stocks, but internally mixed).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak on 1W: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND; V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND; MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY. Sector showing net weakness (Financials 1W: -2.61%); watch for further rotation if credit/earnings headlines change momentum.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare soft with headline choppiness: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND; JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION; UNH (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Healthcare negative (1W: -4.24%) and sensitivity to recent pipeline/news items.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Given CAUTION and narrow leadership, favor selective exposure to proven leaders (INTU, NOW, MPC) and reduce exposure to structurally weak names in Materials and Consumer Staples (CRH, PPG, EL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat recent big 1W rallies as tactical opportunities rather than broad risk-on signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND; MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND; ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.90%) — breadth concentrated and should be monitored for continuation. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.43%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -2.94%) — downside breadth and headline risk present.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND — watch for failure below this week’s pivot as a signal of broader tech hesitation. AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND — further weakness on a break of recent 1M lows would confirm extended selling. MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND — retention of gains would signal continued energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (+75): Pfizer (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — positive China obesity/cancer headlines but price is soft short-term, a divergence to monitor. (Other high-scoring bullish headlines noted in the feed — verify timeframes before adding size.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
F (-80): Ford (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND — recall headline confirms price action. MNST (-55): Monster Beverage (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND — earnings-driven negative flow aligns with sell-off. WMT (-55): Walmart (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND — downgrade/FTC noise confirming pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with mixed style (mixed / no clear leadership) as breadth is weak and leadership concentrated in a few tech names. INTU, NOW and MPC showing clear strength (INTU ABOVE TREND; NOW ABOVE TREND; MPC ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major divergence across large caps (MSFT, AMZN, MA, IBM showing 1W/1M disagreement) and several bullish headlines (e.g., PFE +75) not yet confirmed by price — watch for trend breaks.
